summary: 1. **Low severity bug for `scope === "open"`, `covered = code.slice(d.line, stop)` starts on the line *after* the comment, while `line`/`next` scopes start *at* the comment's line. Oxlint suppresses same-line trailing code after an inline block directive, but the approval-identity window excludes it — the one placement where the window errs narrow instead of wide. Scenario: run adds an inline block disable, user approves, later commit edits same-line code after the comment → check doesn't re-ask. Full-line disables unaffected. Fix: start the open window at `d.line`.
